title: SustainabilityResult
description: Structured sustainability and ESG research answer for the marine fuels and shipping-services lens (Poseidon Phase 8, doc 02 section 4.3 -- the existing-customer brief's research subskill, first call). Minimal v1 -- versioned by filename, matching web_research.json's own convention: a future revision ships as sustainability_v2.json rather than mutating this file.

items.description: Individual sustainability/ESG findings, ordered by relevance as returned by the model.

label.description: Short name of the sustainability/ESG theme or commitment (e.g. a carbon-reduction pledge, an alternative marine fuel pilot).

detail.description: The specific finding, commitment, or evidence behind this theme.

relevance.description: Why this theme matters to a marine fuels and shipping-services sales conversation.

summary.description: A short overall synthesis of the sustainability/ESG items, in the marine fuels and shipping-services lens.
